headerDisplay: Add the Macs to wake. On each Mac, turn on "Wake for network access" in System Settings.

ip.title: IP address (recommended)
ip.description: With an IP the switch reflects the real state of the Mac (ping) and the packet is also sent as unicast. Use a DHCP reservation.

statusPort.title: TCP status port (optional)
statusPort.description: If the Mac does not answer ping (firewall in stealth mode), check a TCP port instead, e.g. 22 or 5900.

broadcastAddress.title: Broadcast address (optional)
broadcastAddress.description: If empty, uses 255.255.255.255 and the broadcast address of every local interface.

sendUnicast.title: Also send as unicast to the IP

sleepCommand.title: Sleep command (optional)
sleepCommand.description: Run when the switch is turned Off. E.g. ssh user@192.168.1.50 pmset sleepnow
